# Alu Studio

> Indie app studio building small, focused iOS/Android apps.

## Apps

- [Home](https://alu-studio.com/home/): Indie app studio — tools for everyday life. Pikgeon, Babbby, Sotto, and DingPOS.
- [Pikgeon](https://alu-studio.com/pikgeon/): Keep your postcard memories organized. Smart OCR tracks your mailing journey, fully processed on-device for privacy.
- [Babbby](https://alu-studio.com/babbby/): Daily activity ideas for your little one, ages 0–6. Track milestones, build routines, and make every day count.
- [Sotto](https://alu-studio.com/sotto/): Remember the details that matter. Keep track of the little things about the people you care about.
- [DingPOS](https://alu-studio.com/dingpos/): Open your store in 10 minutes. A server-less, offline-first point of sale for iPad. Your data, your control.
